data.one_liner: Flutter common utilities for SharedPreferences, screen adaptation, directories, and widgets.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of utility classes including SpUtil for SharedPreferences, ScreenUtil for screen adaptation and dimensions, DirectoryUtil for file paths, and WidgetUtil for widget rendering bounds and image sizes.
use_when: You need quick helper utilities for SharedPreferences data storage
You require screen adaptation and sizing metrics in your Flutter app
You need to easily check image dimensions or widget bounds
avoid_when: You prefer modern reactive state management and dependency injection
You only need isolated small helpers where a full utility bundle is unnecessary
strengths: Combines multiple essential utilities in one package
Easy synchronous access to SharedPreferences after initialization
Provides handy screen metrics and adaptation helpers
weaknesses: Some utility classes have been split into separate packages like sp_util
data.setup_notes: Initialize SpUtil in main using await SpUtil.getInstance() if using SharedPreferences synchronously.
